name: Beezaasan Explotech Ltd
tagline: Recently listed, high-return commercial-explosives microcap (ROCE ~23%, ROE ~21%, D/E ~0.24) serving cement, mining, defence and Border Roads / PSU customers - the profile of an early-stage compounder in the same licensed, structurally growing space that produced Solar Industries, but it came from an untrusted X tip, has already run ~85% to an all-time high, and could not be deep-read this pass (no ValuePickr thread)
business_overview: Manufacturer and supplier of industrial explosives and accessories - slurry and emulsion explosives and detonating fuse - for cement, mining, infrastructure, defence, the Border Roads Organisation and PSUs. Small and newly listed (BSE 544369); explosives require PESO / statutory licensing, and proximity-to-customer logistics is a structural feature of the industry. TTM revenue ~Rs 212 Cr, PAT ~Rs 13.4 Cr. P/E ~40x after the ~85% run - a microcap premium
fundamentals_narrative: On the numbers this is an attractive small business - low debt, ~23% ROCE, ~21% ROE, and it operates in the industrial-explosives market that is licensed (a regulatory entry barrier), logistics-moated, and structurally tied to India's mining, cement and infrastructure capex - the exact space in which Solar Industries compounded into a 100-bagger. The reservations are: (1) the lead is an untrusted X post with a multibagger framing; (2) the stock has already re-rated ~85% and trades at ~40x earnings; (3) it is newly listed with limited disclosure history; and (4) with no ValuePickr thread and only a web pass, the primary documents (RHP / annual report / concalls / capacity and defence-order detail) have not been read. The fundamentals justify a proper primary-doc deep-dive before any return-magnitude label is assigned.
